name: Handed
description: Describes someone whose BCI feeds, social data, and neural overlays are so thoroughly curated and managed — typically by a corponation's Tier 4-5 lifestyle package — that they effectively only receive information that has been 'handed' to them. To call someone 'handed' is to say their perception of reality is a managed product. The term emerged from BCI technicians in Tier 2-3 who serviced Tier 4 units and recognized the architecture of curated information environments.
cultural_impact: The term has sharpened class consciousness around BCI usage in GLMZ, distinguishing between people who navigate raw information (associated with the Gray Zone resilience) and people who receive pre-filtered neural feeds (associated with corporate dependency). 'Are you handed or are you looking?' has become a shorthand question about someone's relationship to truth.
key_figures: Technician Yuki Andersen-Chibueze (Tier 2 BCI repair, credited with coining the term)
The Rawfeed Collective (underground BCI modification group)
locations: Rawfeed Collective meeting spaces, rotating Tier 1-2 locations
story_hooks: A Tier 4 executive discovers they have been 'handed' their entire career — every major decision shaped by curated BCI feeds managed by their corponation — and must decide what to do with the realization that their life's choices were products.

The Rawfeed Collective is offering illegal BCI modifications that strip curation architecture — but the raw information feed is so overwhelming that some users are not surviving the transition. Someone needs to find out if it's a flaw or a feature.
A journalist trying to expose a corponation's handed architecture is themselves handed — and doesn't know it. Someone in the Gray Zone who can see the seams has to decide whether to help them.
definition: Describes a person whose BCI feeds are so thoroughly curated by corporate architecture that they only receive pre-approved information. To be handed is to have your perception managed for you. Implies both privilege and a kind of blindness. Opposite of 'rawfeeding' (experiencing unfiltered BCI data).
usage_example: 'Don't argue with him about the Gray Zone water situation — he's handed six ways from Sunday, he literally cannot receive information that contradicts his package.'
spread: Common in Tier 2-3; used as a pointed insult toward Tier 4-5; beginning to appear in Tier 1 speech as a general term for willful ignorance even among non-BCI users.
